summary: Terminal validator and receipt publisher; plan acceptance-coordinator-trust-recovery; full validation covers slices R0-R5 and registered commands; slice mode validates one slice; enforces authority, authorization, knowledge, skill-input, terminal-receipt, resume-state, and binding checks; requires confined paths and matching SHA-256 hashes; candidate manifest contains 8 declared sources and excludes generated paths; passed full runs publish immutable completion receipt and transition resume/plan state; failures return nonzero; unknown slices or missing directories fail; receipt lookup falls back to newest matching JSON when resume pointer is unavailable
